# wso2is_authenticators (Data Source)

Lists the authenticators that login flows can use. The list includes local authenticators (use `idp = "LOCAL"` in `authentication_sequence`) and the federated authenticators of identity providers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "wso2is_authenticators" "local" {
  type = "LOCAL"
}

output "local_authenticators" {
  value = [for a in data.wso2is_authenticators.local.authenticators : a.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Filter by type: `LOCAL`, `REQUEST_PATH` or `FEDERATED`.

### Read-Only

- `authenticators` (Attributes List) Authenticators, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authenticators))

<a id="nestedatt--authenticators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authenticators`

Read-Only:

- `defined_by` (String) `SYSTEM` or `USER` (custom).
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `id` (String) ID.
- `name` (String) Name used in `authentication_sequence` (for federated ones, the identity provider name).
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags, for example `MFA`, `Passwordless`, `Social-Login`.
- `type` (String) `LOCAL`, `REQUEST_PATH` or `FEDERATED`.
